CLAIM: Do peer‑reviewed epidemiological studies report a statistically significant link between prenatal maternal stress and autism spectrum disorder in children?
EVIDENCE:
[source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9363685/]
Standard-dose paracetamol was administered at 15 mg/kg per dose. High-dose paracetamol was administered at 20 mg/kg per dose in the intervention group, ages 6 months to 5 years. Hepatotoxicity with paracetamol is very rare in children if it is used in the therapeutic range (<=75 mg/kg per day orally or intravenously or <=100 mg/kg per day rectally). A single dose of high-dose paracetamol (20 mg/kg/dose) was safe and had a similar antipyretic effect as mefenamic acid.
